Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2026

🔒 No telemetry. No accounts. No servers.

What data Breath Break collects

Breath Break collects nothing from you and sends nothing to any server — not now, not in any paid tier.

  • Your settings (breathing pattern, interval, audio mode, theme, target sites) are stored in chrome.storage.sync — synced across your own Chrome devices by Google's infrastructure, invisible to us.
  • Your mood check-ins and session streak are stored in chrome.storage.local — local to this device only. We cannot read them. Google cannot read them.
  • We do not collect: browsing history, page content, keystrokes, identifiers, IP addresses, or any analytics events.

Network requests

Breath Break makes zero outbound network requests in all tiers through Phase 4 of development. The only network activity is:

  • Audio files (chime, music, voice clips) loaded from the extension bundle itself — no CDN, no remote server.
  • The crisis-support link in Settings footer opens a third-party website in your browser when you click it. That navigation is subject to that site's own privacy policy.

Permissions explained

  • storage — save your settings and streak locally.
  • alarms — schedule when the next breath break should appear.
  • tabs + activeTab — detect which site is active to decide whether to show the overlay.
  • scripting — lower the volume of background music on Spotify / YouTube tabs during a session (optional, only when audio is enabled).

We do not use these permissions to read page content or track your browsing.

Exporting your data

You can download a full JSON copy of all your stored data at any time from the Settings page → Export data. The file includes your settings, mood history, and session streak. Nothing is held back.

Deleting your data

Uninstalling Breath Break from Chrome removes all chrome.storage.local data automatically. To also clear synced settings, open Settings → scroll to the footer → Clear all data before uninstalling.

Children

Breath Break does not knowingly collect data from anyone. Since no data is collected at all, there is nothing age-specific to disclose.

Changes to this policy

If we ever add network features (e.g. live TTS in a future version), this policy will be updated and the extension changelog will note it explicitly. We will not add telemetry silently.
